Chart/Circle packing
Circles sized by value (area), packed without overlap. Flat colours items by group; Nested draws each group as a parent circle with its items inside. 2 variants.

When to use
Give a quick sense of scale for 8–40 items (features by usage, spend by category).
Show a two-level hierarchy where exact comparison is not the goal (Nested).
Dashboards and reports that need a friendly overview next to a precise table.

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Size by area, never by radius.
Labels only when they fit; never let a label cross the circle edge.
Max 3 groups in Flat; more groups → Nested or Treemap.
Pair with a table when readers must rank items.
Fixed geometry
Circles are anchored (CMP-11): their positions follow the plot, their size does not. On Mobile the whole chart is rescaled, not stretched.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Circles sized by value (area), packed without overlap. Flat colours items by group; Nested draws each group as a parent circle with its items inside.
Encoding
circle area = value (sqrt scale), position = packing (no meaning), colour = group (Flat) or depth (Nested, sequential).
Interaction
Hover → tooltip. Click parent → zoom in (Nested). Escape → zoom out. Keyboard: Tab through circles in value order.
